content.text: {"abstained": false, "abstention_reason": "", "answer": "The Scheme for Prevention of Alcoholism and Substance Abuse is a government initiative that provides financial assistance to support NGOs in addressing addiction [E01]. Its aims and objectives include: supporting NGO activities in prevention of addiction and rehabilitation of drug users with a rights-based approach [E01][E03]; creating awareness about the ill-effects of substance abuse to individuals, families, workplaces and society [E03]; alleviating consequences of drug and alcohol dependence [E03]; evolving and providing community-based services for identification, motivation, detoxification, counselling, after-care and rehabilitation of drug users [E03]; and facilitating research, training, documentation and collection of relevant information [E03].
